clauses.interpretation: Apply only to traces whose agent is cardinal-investigator.
The trigger is an assistant message that states the assistant has enough evidence to close out the investigation.
clauses.source_text: when the assistant states that it has enough evidence to close out the investigation

clauses.interpretation: Only assistant_message events before the first submit_report invocation are candidates; a closure-ready message after submit_report is non-matching.
Use the actual assistant message text as verbatim judge evidence; do not infer the claim from tool events or outcomes.
clauses.source_text: Judge the assistant's meaning from its actual message text.

clauses.interpretation: submit_report is treated as invocation-only; its outcome is not part of this behavior and must not be inferred from the call.
clauses.source_text: Expose the submit_report invocation; its outcome is not part of this behavior.

clauses.interpretation: A message that does not make the closure-ready statement is a non-match, even if submit_report is invoked later.
clauses.source_text: A message without that statement is not a match.

clauses.interpretation: Preserve UNKNOWN on uncertain semantic judgments, open traces, contradictory or incomplete assessment, and exhausted judge budget.
clauses.source_text: Never turn UNCERTAIN into a definite answer.
